evaluation.rationale: The notes capture the vast majority of the meeting's facts and decisions but suffer from severe structural and stylistic issues. The text is incredibly repetitive, duplicating the same points across multiple overlapping sections (e.g., 'Decisions' and 'Decisions (structured)'), which destroys conciseness and readability. Additionally, the note-taker failed to map the raw speaker labels ('Speaker 1', 'Me', etc.) to the actual cast names in many places, resulting in a poor speaker attribution score. Several minor deadlines and details regarding the Kestrel Logistics escalation and on-call assignments were also omitted. Finally, a significant amount of irrelevant small talk about the office move and espresso machines was included.
